brute_force: Check service retry loops, typing errors, and authorized tests.
Recommend review of source access policy
Require approval before any real account/access change
password_spray: A misconfigured identity integration may target many users.
disabled_account: Account-state synchronization or stale fictional flags may be responsible.
Verify disabled status at event time
unusual_time: Shift work or approved maintenance can explain the event.
Check approved work schedule and UTC conversion
failure_ratio: An identity service outage could cause benign failures.
Compare failure counts with total volume
Coordinate any changes with the service owner
access_denied: Application permission drift may cause repeated denied reads.
Require an approved change before permission modification
configuration_change: Authorized maintenance may be missing from the change calendar.
device_health: Sensor noise or simulator calibration may explain telemetry.
Do not isolate industrial equipment automatically
